applications.zh: 家庭, 汽车, 办公室, 厨房

description.en:
Our robot vacuums combine LDS laser navigation with powerful 4000Pa suction to deliver thorough, intelligent cleaning. The 3-in-1 sweep, vacuum, and mop design handles all floor types, while multi-floor mapping stores up to 5 maps for different levels of your home.

Smart features include app control via Tuya/Smart Life, voice control with Alexa and Google Home, auto recharge, and scheduled cleaning. The 5200mAh battery provides up to 150 minutes of runtime, and the 20mm climbing ability easily crosses thresholds and rugs.

We offer full OEM/ODM services: custom colors, branding, packaging, and even firmware customization for large orders. MOQ 200 units, sample available in 7-14 days.
description.zh:
我们的扫地机器人将LDS激光导航与4000Pa强劲吸力相结合，提供彻底而智能的清洁体验。扫拖一体设计适用于所有地面类型，多层地图功能可存储最多5张地图。

智能功能包括Tuya/Smart Life APP控制、Alexa和Google Home语音控制、自动回充和定时清扫。5200mAh电池提供长达150分钟续航，20mm越障能力轻松跨越门槛和地毯。

我们提供完整的OEM/ODM服务：定制颜色、品牌、包装，大订单甚至支持固件定制。最小起订量200台，样品7-14天。
